_comment: Copy to a private location, verify every figure against the provider's own pricing page, set verified_at to the date you checked, and point SP_PRICING_FILE at it. Entries with an empty verified_at are rejected on purpose: the app will not start in live mode until each price has been checked. Zero prices are rejected unless "free": true.
